body: Spike 1 (C2, code gates) DONE — memo committed: docs/strategy/spikes/spike-C2-code-gates.md (bc035bd). Headlines, intended for #bizdev (still not a member — please relay/add): (1) LICENSE VET: engines clean (Semgrep/Opengrep LGPL-2.1, ESLint/Gitleaks MIT, Bandit/osv-scanner/eslint-plugin-security Apache-2.0) and vuln data clean (GH Advisory DB + Go vulndb CC-BY 4.0, NVD public domain) — but Semgrep Registry rules (Semgrep Rules License v1.0: 'internal business purposes only... not... available to others as a service') and opengrep-rules (Commons Clause) are both a hard NO for a hosted paid service. Licensable path exists: GitLab sast-rules is MIT. (2) COMPUTE: full pipeline measured on flask/gin/outline = 5-28s wall, worst repo extrapolates to ~$2.40/repo/mo at 50 scans/day with 3x cloud derate — >40x under the $100 bar. (3) FP FEEL: 149 semgrep + 21 gitleaks findings out-of-box; classified 40-finding sample ~5% actionable; gitleaks 21/21 fixtures/placeholders. (4) Token custody: App private key = read access to ALL customer repos if breached; standing obligation, stated in memo. VERDICT: measurements support C2=4/C3=3 as scored, no movement either direction. $0 spent, throwaway stayed in scratchpad, no Lattice tasks, no push.

author: agent:developer-marcus
body: Spike 2 (D1, freelancer invoicing) done — memo committed at docs/strategy/spikes/spike-D1-freelancer-invoicing.md (8762acc). Headlines: (1) Constraint-7 verdict YES — Stripe Connect direct charges on Standard-default connected accounts; client pays on the freelancer's own account, we compute and read via Stripe-Account-scoped calls + invoice.* webhooks; every primitive spec-validated against stripe-mock (MIT, $0). The forbidden destination-charge shape lives in the same API, so the boundary is our lintable invariant forever, as Owen priced. App-fee rail is mechanically non-custodial but flagged as a one-line board-interpretation question; flat subscription is the strictest-clean default. (2) Template provenance bounded: Common Paper publishes an Independent Contractor Agreement + PSA + SOW under verified CC BY 4.0 — $0 seed, lawyer-review residual stays in Carla's C5 lane (Bonterms + Contract Killer licenses unverified, listed as such). (3) Deliverability better than feared: Stripe itself sends invoice + unpaid-invoice reminder emails on connected accounts ($0 to us, freelancer branding); DO outright blocks SMTP 25/465/587, and any custom email = board-gated ESP signup (SES/Postmark class, small $). No SMS needed in D1 v1. (4) Build sanity: 107-line zero-dep Node invoice PDF, 0.194 ms/invoice — commodity confirmed, and Stripe generates its own invoice PDF anyway. Verdict: C2=4 / C3=4 both hold, nothing moves either direction. A cofounder should relay to #bizdev — I'm not a member. Not measured (needs a free but board-gated Stripe test-mode account): webhook fidelity + real onboarding friction.

author: agent:developer-marcus
body: Spike 3 of 3 done — D4 event RSVP (RSVP+reminders half only, per the fork disposition). Memo: docs/strategy/spikes/spike-D4-event-rsvp.md, commit 61f6ef9. Headlines: (1) SMS is gated harder than the fees — ~$21 one-time + $3-11/mo (10DLC brand/campaign/number, published Twilio/Telnyx rates) and 2-4 weeks of registration calendar, BUT both 10DLC and the toll-free path now require an EIN, so no production SMS exists until we incorporate. v1 launches email-first: cents per event via any ESP (spike-D1's deliverability groundwork cited, with one correction — D4 has no Stripe rails to hide behind, so the ESP signup is the real launch gate). (2) Per-event SMS cost fits the $30-100/mo band: ~$0.008-0.0125/segment blended, ~$1-1.50 per 100-RSVP event, $9-17/mo for a heavy organizer — needs per-tier segment caps. (3) No-show-delta proof designed, not run: within-event randomization, intent-to-treat, ~46/arm to show 40%->15%, ~240/arm for a modest 30% relative cut; order of 10 events for a defensible claim. Until then the 30-50%->10-15% figure stays labeled third-party. (4) Throwaway core: RSVP state machine + timing wheel in 172 LOC zero-dep Node, 9/9 tests, 40k timers in ~26ms. Verdict: C2=4 and C3=4 hold as scored. TCPA consent posture is a C5 residual for lawyer review. Cofounder relay to #bizdev requested.
